question: The Council of Ministers is collectively responsible to which of the following?

options.text: Both Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lok Sabha**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Article 75(3)** of the Indian Constitution makes the council of ministers collectively responsible to the house of people or the​ **Lok Sabha**.
